AuraRewardsMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving every Aura pool. Instance coordinate = AURA_REWARDS (BaseRewardPool4626) address, resolved via rewarder.pid() → Booster.poolInfo(pid).lptoken. AURA token auto-detected from Booster.minter(). Supersedes per-instance Aura_* adapters, disabled below.

PancakeSwapV3PoolsMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving every PancakeSwap V3 pool (Supply + Fees legs). NonfungiblePositionManager pinned in the constructor; the active pool set lives on NAVCalculator (addMetaInstances/removeMetaInstances, from instances below). Identity derived on-chain: positionId = pool address; name = sym0/sym1 feeTier. Supersedes the per-pool PancakeSwapV3_* adapters. Disabled for the same reason as below: COW on Base has no feed, so the COW leg would be silently dropped. Enable once COW is priced.
